howTo: Click “Choose PDF file” and select the PDF you want to reorganize.
Drag page rows into the new order, or use the arrow buttons.
Check the order preview line to confirm the sequence.
keyFacts: Reordering builds a new document by copying pages in your chosen sequence — the original file is never modified.
Each row shows the page's original number, so you always know what moves where.
The order preview lists the new sequence as original page numbers: “4, 1, 2, 3”.
copyPages preserves each page's size, fonts and images exactly.
The result is saved with object streams for a compact file.

limitations: Pages cannot be duplicated here — each original page appears exactly once.
Interactive form fields and bookmarks are not preserved in the new order.
Very large PDFs (50 MB+) are not accepted to protect browser memory.
Password-protected PDFs must be unlocked before reorganizing.
